title: Discriminative Span as a Predictor of Synthetic Data Utility via Classifier Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2605.09697v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In many real-world computer vision applications, including medical imaging and industrial inspection, binary classification tasks are characterized by a severe scarcity of positive samples. A widely adopted solution is to generate synthetic positive data using image-to-image transformations applied to negative samples. However, a fundamental challenge remains: how can we reliably assess whether such synthetic data will improve downstream model performance? In this work, we propose a geometry-driven metric that predicts the utility of synthetic data without requiring model training. Our approach operates in the embedding space of a pre-trained foundation model and represents the dataset through difference vectors between samples. We evaluate whether the weight vector of a linear classifier can be expressed within the subspace spanned by these variations by measuring the relative projection error. translated_title: 通过分类器重构将判别性张成空间作为合成数据效用的预测器
translated_abstract: 在许多现实世界的计算机视觉应用中，包括医学影像和工业检测，二分类任务的特点是正样本极度稀缺。一种被广泛采用的解决方案是通过对负样本施加图像到图像的变换来生成合成的正样本数据。然而，一个根本性的挑战依然存在：我们如何可靠地评估此类合成数据是否会提升下游模型的性能？在这项工作中，我们提出了一种几何驱动的度量方法，能够在不需要模型训练的情况下预测合成数据的效用。我们的方法在预训练基础模型的嵌入空间中运行，并通过样本之间的差分向量来表示数据集。我们通过测量相对投影误差，来评估线性分类器的权重向量是否可以表示在这些变化所张成的子空间内。直观地说，如果这些变化…
tldr: 该论文提出一种几何驱动的度量方法，通过在预训练基础模型嵌入空间中衡量线性分类器权重向量与样本差分向量所张成子空间之间的相对投影误差，无需训练模型即可预测合成正样本数据对下游二分类任务的效用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a geometry-driven metric that predicts the utility of synthetic data for downstream binary classification without model training, by measuring the relative projection error between a linear classifier's weight vector and the subspace spanned by difference vectors in a pre-trained foundation model's embedding space.
